help.title: How to use BikeBuddy
help.a1: Upload GPX tracks from your rides — cycling or motorcycling — and see them as routes on an interactive map.
help.a2: Sign in to upload tours and save them to your account. Your profile lets you set a display name, switch language, export your data, or delete your account.
help.a3: Click Upload GPX, give it a name, and drop a .gpx file. It appears on the map straight away.
help.a4: Use the search box to filter by name or description and the sort menu to order by date, name, or length. Toggle In view to show only tours visible on the current map.
help.a5: Click Select in the sidebar to check off several tours and delete them together.
help.a6: Click a tour to focus it; Show All Tours brings back every route on the map.
help.a7: Open a tour to add, view, or delete photos. Toggle Photo pins on the map to show geotagged photos where they were taken.
help.a8: Tap a tour to open its details, swipe it right to delete it, or press and hold it to select several.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: BikeBuddy stores the rides and photos you upload and shows them on a map. This notice explains which personal data that involves, who receives it, how long it is kept and which rights you have.
privacy.controllerText: The controller for BikeBuddy under the EU General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) is:
privacy.dataAccount: Your account: the name, email address and account ID from your sign-in with Microsoft, and the language you choose.
privacy.dataRides: Your rides: the GPX files you upload, the tracks, dates and statistics derived from them, and the names and descriptions you give them. A track shows where, and often when, you rode.
privacy.dataPhotos: Your photos: resized copies of the photos you add; the originals are not kept. If a photo contains a GPS position in its EXIF data, BikeBuddy reads it and stores it with the photo to place it on the map. No other EXIF data is kept.
privacy.dataTechnical: Technical data: your IP address and the time of each request, which the hosting services process to deliver the site and keep it secure.
privacy.purposeHeading: Why, and on which legal basis
privacy.purposeService: To provide the service you signed up for: storing your rides and photos and showing them to you (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR, performance of a contract).
privacy.purposeSecurity: To keep the service secure and available, for example against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR, legitimate interests).
privacy.purposeNone: BikeBuddy uses no advertising, no tracking and no analytics, and does not sell your data or use it for anything else.
privacy.recipientsMicrosoft: Microsoft hosts the service in its Azure data centres in the North Europe region (Ireland): the API, the database and the file storage. Sign-in runs through Microsoft Entra External ID. Microsoft processes this data on our behalf.
privacy.recipientsCarto: CARTO serves the map images. To draw the map, your browser loads the images for the area you are looking at from CARTO's servers, which shows CARTO your IP address and that area, often around your home or your rides. The map data comes from OpenStreetMap.
privacy.recipientsGithub: GitHub (a Microsoft company) hosts this website on GitHub Pages and sees your IP address when your browser loads it.
privacy.recipientsTransfer: These providers may also process data outside the EU, for example in the United States. Where they do, they rely on the safeguards the GDPR provides for this, such as the EU standard contractual clauses.
privacy.retentionUntilDeleted: Your rides and photos are kept until you delete them or your account. Deleting a ride or a photo removes it at once.
privacy.retentionAccount: Deleting your account removes all your BikeBuddy data at once. Your sign-in account is deleted within a day; Microsoft Entra then keeps it for up to 30 days before removing it for good.
privacy.retentionBackups: Backups can hold deleted data a little longer: the database keeps 7 days of backups, and deleted files stay recoverable for 14 days.
privacy.retentionLogs: Technical logs are kept only as long as the hosting services need them to run the service.
privacy.browserHeading: What is stored in your browser
privacy.browserText: BikeBuddy keeps your sign-in session, your language and your map line style in your browser's local storage, so they survive a reload, and caches the app's files so it starts faster. It sets no tracking cookies.
privacy.rightsText: You can see and correct your data in the app, download all of it and delete your account in your profile. You also have the right of access, rectification, erasure, restriction of processing, data portability and objection, and you can lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority. For anything else, write to the contact above.
